lesson.close.title: Almost
lesson.close.body: You got {got}. Look at the hint and try again.
lesson1.title: Your first words
lesson1.body: Type in Latin. The word is underlined until you press Space.
lesson1.why: The underline means Buuz is still working on the word.
lesson1.success: You typed your first Mongolian words.
lesson2.title: Vowels match the word
lesson2.body: In a word with э, ө or ү, o becomes ө and u becomes ү.
lesson2.why: You type o and u. Buuz picks о or ө, у or ү.
lesson2.success: Buuz matched the vowels for you.
lesson2.off: Vowel matching is off. Turn it on in Typing, or skip this lesson.
lesson3.title: q for ө, w for ү
lesson3.body: Use q and w when you want ө or ү for sure, also at the start of a word.
lesson3.why: q and w are free keys in Mongolian, so Buuz uses them.
lesson3.success: ө and ү whenever you want them.
lesson4.title: ' for ь, " for ъ
lesson4.body: The apostrophe gives the soft sign. Shift and apostrophe give the hard sign.
lesson4.why: The ' key is next to Return on most keyboards.
lesson5.title: Space and Enter finish a word
lesson5.body: Type nom. It stays underlined. Press Enter to finish it.
lesson5.why: Space, Enter, Tab and punctuation all finish the word.
lesson5.close: The word is still underlined. Press Enter.
lesson5.success: The word is finished and sent.
lesson6.title: Backspace undoes a change
lesson6.body: Type tov and Space. Buuz makes it төв. Press Backspace right after to get тов.
lesson6.why: This works for word choice, abbreviations and autocorrect.
lesson6.close: Press Backspace right after Space, before you type anything else.
lesson6.off: Word choice is off. Turn it on in Typing, or skip this lesson.
lesson7.title: Esc keeps Latin
lesson7.body: For a name like zoom, press Esc before Space. The word stays in Latin.
lesson7.why: Press Esc again to get the Cyrillic back.
lesson8.title: Short forms
lesson8.body: Some short forms grow into full words at Space.
lesson8.why: See all short forms in Typing › Abbreviations.
lesson8.off: Abbreviations are off. Turn them on in Typing, or skip this lesson.
